sites.evidence: macOS 27.3 (26C5035r) AppleMobileFileIntegrity's only GOT slot for PAGE_SHIFT_CONST. Its only reader is _CEElementIterate (0xfffffe0009854668), the CoreEntitlements DER iterator's stack check (sp & ((1 << *slot) - 1) < 0x80 takes the error exit), as in the 24A446 fixture. With the page shift (12) on the native 4 KiB kernel it fired inside a good stack: AMFI panicked "failed to create OSDictionary copy: 14" spawning the launchd boot task after fsck (exec_check_security_entitlement, load_machfile). Bound to unixnu_kernel_stack_shift, the stack allocation alignment shift, for which sp & mask stays at least 8 KiB inside any stack. Other components keep PAGE_SHIFT_CONST for page arithmetic.
